sloka: इमौ कुमारौ सौमित्रे तव धर्मविशारदौ ।अङ्गदश्चन्द्रकेतुश्च राज्यार्थे दृढविक्रमौ ।। ७.१०२.२ ॥
transliteration: imau kumārau saumitre tava dharmaviśāradau ।aṅgadaścandraketuśca rājyārthe dṛḍhavikramau ।। 7.102.2 ॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, these two sons of yours, Angada and Chandraketu, are skilled in righteousness and possess firm valor suitable for kingship.
